classification_notes: This proof will not guess localhost, NAS, or Docker ports.
Set a candidate admin-web root URL when a local or staged candidate exists.

gates.title: Candidate proof has no runtime side effects
gates.evidence: The proof uses GET requests only and never starts Docker, enables workers, writes NAS files, repairs usage-events, recovers jobs, publishes indexes, or changes Cutter protocols.

gates.title: Candidate target URL is explicit
gates.required_evidence: Set MIXLAB_ADMIN_DOCKER_CANDIDATE_BASE_URL to a local or staged admin-web root.

gates.title: Candidate target is an admin-web root
gates.required_evidence: Use an admin-web root URL, not NAS desktop, a subpath, query, or hash.

gates.title: Candidate proof is not NAS live release evidence
gates.evidence: This report always sets nas_live_evidence=false and cannot replace admin-docker-release-live-readonly.
gates.required_evidence: Run the separate NAS live-readonly probe after a staged target exists.

gates.title: Candidate Admin Web root is reachable
gates.required_evidence: GET / must return an Admin Web response from the candidate target.

gates.title: Candidate exposes current Admin API endpoints
gates.evidence: auth=request not run; release_gates=request not run; data_loading=request not run

gates.title: Candidate exposes version/health parity contract
gates.evidence: version_health_parity contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose version_health_parity with expected services, GET preflight endpoints, external proof requirements, and no ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate exposes disk-space protection contract
gates.evidence: disk_space_protection contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose disk_space_protection with GET preflight endpoints and no worker/ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate exposes usage-events repair contract
gates.evidence: usage_events_repair contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose usage_events_repair dry-run/apply commands with usage-events-only scope and no ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate exposes processing recovery contract
gates.evidence: processing_recovery contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose processing_recovery preflight scope, idle-supervisor requirement, and no ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate exposes admin-worker env proof contract
gates.evidence: admin_worker_env_proof contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose admin_worker_env_proof with disabled standalone worker flags, /data/PublicLibrary roots, proof command, no secrets, no worker start, and no ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate exposes Cutter compatibility proof contract
gates.evidence: cutter_compatibility_proof contract is missing or incomplete.
gates.required_evidence: release-gates must expose cutter_compatibility_proof with Windows acceptance and real-cut requirements, staged-candidate boundary, and no ready/Cutter mutations.

gates.title: Candidate proof does not approve Docker upload
gates.evidence: docker_upload_allowed=false and staging_approved=false are hard-coded in this report.
gates.required_evidence: Docker upload requires separate NAS live-readonly, parity, worker, Cutter, staging-tag, rollback, disk, and release decision gates.

result.summary: Candidate contract proof remains blocked until the candidate exposes the required current API and release-gate contracts.
